title: 26 U.S. Code 482, Allocation of income and deductions among taxpayers

passages.question: Does the job for the Vice President's company have to be at arm's length?
passages.excerpt: In any case of two or more organizations, trades, or businesses (whether or not incorporated, whether or not organized in the United States, and whether or not affiliated) owned or controlled directly or indirectly by the same interests, the Secretary may distribute, apportion, or allocate gross income, deductions, credits, or allowances between or among such organizations, trades, or businesses ...
